# Expected values for the removal of a finished bakery (docs/rules/baking.md, docs/rules/removal.md), captured from the original
# program in the emulator (ADR 0008): tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb remove with a finished bakery (type 16, a large building,
# object code 3) at the flag 15,9 and the remove click on its node. Its flag pointer (+0xe) is set by hand, as a built site leaves it
# (0x43ef82); the pointer's high bytes are left out of the building's bytes. The lines are the verb's output, reduced to the changes of the
# map, the baker (s3: a settler without a job the castle made the baker), the flags, the building (b2), the table counts (c), and the
# generator (rng); the castle's knights (s6 to s8) and the carriers are left out. A scenario has the baker inside waiting for flour
# (baker-inside), baking (baker-working), out on the flag with the bread (baker-out), and, with a flour from the castle's flag (put at
# the pass 600), the flour on its way to the bakery (baker-flour-on-the-way). Not production code: no routine of the program is transcribed
# here, only values the program produced.
